sections.title: The problem
sections.html:
The problem

What it is there to fix.

Reports are written under time pressure

Mandatory facts get missed while the complainant waits, and the gap is discovered weeks later.

Section selection is inconsistent

The same offence attracts different sections at different stations, which creates problems at trial.

Duplicate complaints go unnoticed

The same incident is registered twice from different sources with nothing linking the two.

sections.title: How it works
sections.html:
How it works

From input to outcome.

  1. ReceiveFrom AI CopWriter, a scanned petition or the desk
  2. ExtractWho, what, when, where, property, accused
  3. SuggestStatutory sections and report fields filled in
  4. VerifyThe officer checks, edits and approves
  5. RegisterPushed to crime records; copy to complainant

Station writersStation house officers
